notes: Two לְ morphemes go unrepresented for different reasons: the ethical dative because the ASV writes a reflexive pronoun the suffix carries (rule 40), and the resultative because היה has already taken the written 'be' (rule 21).
The article on הַנִּקְהָלִים takes the relative 'that' under rule 41, leaving 'are assembled' with the participle and its construction-supplied copula.
